partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Direct inhibition of gain-of-function disease gene
results.hypothesis: Directly decreasing a gene whose gain-of-function variants cause disease is a directionally corrective treatment mechanism.
results.body: drug binds and decreases gene; Gene2Phenotype disease assertion specifies gain-of-function variant form
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule aligns drug action with explicit disease direction using a manually curated gain-of-function assertion, rather than assuming every causal gene should be inhibited.
results.trapi_notes: The direct target and directional gene-disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; source, variant-form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(gene:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(gene)
MATCH (gene)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id

results.name: Gain-of-function negative-regulator release countermechanism
results.hypothesis: Inhibiting a negative regulator of a gain-of-function disease gene may release the overactive driver and should be negative evidence.
results.body: drug decreases bound target; SIGNOR target downregulates Gene2Phenotype gain-of-function driver
results.mechanism_rationale: The signed composition predicts increased activity of an explicitly gain-of-function disease driver.
results.trapi_notes: The signed regulation and directional disease paths are TRAPI-expressible; provenance, variant-form, identity, and ontology constraints require post-processing.

results.name: Process- and tissue-localized GOF suppression
results.hypothesis: Signed suppression of a gain-of-function driver is more credible when target and driver share a compact process and affected disease anatomy.
results.body: R164 plus shared compact process and Bgee expression in disease anatomy
results.mechanism_rationale: The rule combines explicit corrective direction with pathway and tissue concordance around the gain-of-function driver.
results.trapi_notes: The positive paths are TRAPI-expressible; shared process and anatomy identity, provenance, compactness, variant form, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[regulation:REGULATES]->(driver:Gene)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (target)-[:INVOLVED_IN]->(process)
      <-[:INVOLVED_IN]-(driver)
MATCH (target)-[target_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]->
      (anatomy:AnatomicalEntity)
      <-[driver_expression:EXPRESSED_IN]-(driver)
MATCH (object)-[:LOCATED_IN|OCCURS_IN]->(anatomy)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND 'infores:signor' IN coalesce(regulation.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND regulation.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND regulation.object_direction_qualifier = 'upregulated'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'gain_of_function_variant_form'
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'decreased'
  AND process._miner_gene_member_degree <= 100
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN
      coalesce(target_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND 'infores:bgee' IN
      coalesce(driver_expression.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
